page.title: Nutrition
page.purpose: Report configured targets against the chosen scope with known subtotals, named missing contributors, and explicit unknown or not-applicable outcomes rather than a universal green badge.

priorities.statement: The selected scope (meal, planned day, recorded so far, expected day, or week) is stated before any figure.
A lower-only target can pass on the known subtotal while its partial completeness stays visible; an upper limit cannot pass while unbounded unknowns remain.
Every unknown names its missing contributors and a concrete next action.
No single badge asserts that all nutrients are covered, and a dinner-only plan never claims full-day compliance.
Supplements are fixed schedules the planner never adjusts; a coverage gap is shown, not dosed away.

states.description: The surface at rest with data present; the state a journey step assumes when it names none.
First read of the page's data; layout is reserved so nothing shifts on arrival.
The read succeeded and there is genuinely nothing, which is distinct from not-yet-loaded.
Some contributing data could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown.
The request failed; the reason and the next available action are stated.
Input was rejected before submission; the offending field is identified next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control says why it is unavailable.
The client cannot reach the API; read-only or queued behavior is explained.
One or more contributions are unknown; the target is reported as unknown rather than pass or fail, with the missing contributors named.
The figures are scoped to what has actually been recorded rather than the planned or expected day.
A target row names the specific contributors lacking a quantity or nutrient value.

elements.description: Selected meal, Planned day, Recorded so far, Expected day, and Selected week.

elements.name: Targets
elements.description: One row per configured target with amount or subtotal, bounds, period, and status.
Pass, fail, unknown, or not applicable, with material required misses sorted first.
The known subtotal, labeled as at-least when unresolved nonnegative contributors remain.
The configured lower and upper bounds with the evaluation period.
Separates data completeness, target evaluation, and evidence quality.
The exact contributors lacking a quantity or nutrient value.
A concrete next action, such as adding a missing label value or leaving coverage unknown.
States that an upper limit cannot pass while unbounded unknown contributions remain.
Fixed supplement schedules contributing to planned and expected views.
The user's selected days, local times, and dose, which the planner does not change.
Expandable per-contributor details behind the summary row.
States that a dinner-only plan cannot claim full-day compliance.

claims.statement: A known subtotal is labeled as at-least when unresolved nonnegative contributors remain and is never presented as the exact total.
An unknown evaluation names the missing contributors and a concrete next action.
An upper bound is not reported as passing while unbounded unknown contributions remain; the limitation is stated.
Planned, expected, and recorded scopes are separately selectable and an occurrence never contributes both planned and actual amounts.
A dinner-only plan states that it cannot claim full-day compliance.
Supplement schedules are shown as fixed user-defined intakes that the planner can flag as a gap but never adjusts.
No aggregate badge asserts universal nutrient coverage; required unknowns remain visible above any reassuring summary.
Unresolved or failed required targets read before satisfied and informational targets.
Each target row exposes its contributing sources and amounts on demand without forcing a full matrix before dinner.
The target summary never scrolls the whole document sideways; columns reflow or scroll within the region.
